requirements.evidence: Contract met: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:56 has only `send(string $title, string $message, array $context = []): void` and no constructor; :61-66 no-ops on null/empty/whitespace config before any HTTP; :68-71 `Http::timeout(5)->connectTimeout(3)->asJson()->post($url, ['content' => ...])`; :84-92 builds title/message/key=value lines and `mb_substr(..., 0, 1800)`; :97-116 redacts sensitive keys (`api[_-]?key`, bearer included), recurses into arrays and JSON-renders them; :73-78 logs non-2xx at error level with `status`; :134-161 catches Throwable and scrubs the URL (raw/encoded/path/webhooks regex) before logging. Logging lanes: config/logging.php:57 default `daily`, :69-82 daily 14 days + `audit` daily 90 days/level info, and no `discord` channel; phpunit.xml:29 pins `LOG_STACK=daily`; .env.example:19,22-27 has all five keys; docs/ops/observability.md:1-60 documents all three lanes with a decision guide.

conventions.evidence: Follows project patterns: no new service/repository layer beyond the task-mandated `App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert`, Blade/Bulma/Livewire/Migrations not involved, sibling style in config files, docs added under `docs/ops/`. Deviations: conventions.md:54 names `docs/ops/logging.md` as the logging doc but the change only adds docs/ops/observability.md:1 and does not update that file or docs/README.md (conventions.md:98); no CHANGELOG.md `[Unreleased]` entry (conventions.md:103); tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:11-63 is the only new test file, consistent with `make:test --pest` style.

security.evidence: No auth/validation surface applies. Secrets: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:97-116 redacts sensitive keys and bearer credentials, recurses into nested arrays, while non-sensitive values like `queue=asaas-webhooks` remain (verified by tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:24-25,34-36); non-2xx logging at :74 contains only status, and transport failures go through :134-161 which strips the exact URL, its encoded forms, its path and any `/webhooks/` URL before `Log::error`; no URL or exception object (trace) is logged. No unescaped output or client-trusted input in the change.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php covers the no-op (:11-18), format+redaction (:20-38), exact 1800-char multibyte truncation (:40-45), non-2xx error log without the token (:47-54), transport exception log (:56-63) and logging config incl. no `discord` channel (:65-72). Gaps: :65-72 only asserts config values, so the task requirement that `Log::channel('audit')->info(...)` actually accepts writes (task.md:61-62) is untested; :12-13 set `config(...)` directly, so the `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL` -> `services.discord.webhook_url` wiring is untested; :9 declares a global `const WEBHOOK`.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses `Http`, `Log` and config, has one public method and small private helpers (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:56-161); no speculative abstraction or duplicated logic. Some extra surface beyond the minimum: Stringable/object branches at :114-116 and :128-129 are not required by the task and are untested, and the scrub at :149-161 handles several encodings/patterns where one URL replacement would likely suffice.

readability.evidence: Clear class/task docblock and method names (`buildText`, `redact`, `format`, `logFailure`, `scrub`), each method small and single-purpose (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:56-161); constants for threshold and patterns (:45-51); docs/ops/observability.md:1-60 is well structured with a lane table, decision guide and env table. No dead code, debug output or style drift from Laravel config siblings.

scope.evidence: Every file in the diff serves the task: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/logging.php:57,69-82, config/services.php discord key, .env.example:19,22-27, phpunit.xml:29, docs/ops/observability.md and tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php. The only marginal additions, `(int)` casts at config/logging.php:72,80, are on the lines being edited and make config types explicit; no unrelated refactors or features.

issues.explanation: conventions.md:54 points readers to `docs/ops/logging.md` for logging guidance, but this change adds a separate `observability.md` and does not update `logging.md` or `docs/README.md`, leaving two logging docs (one possibly stale) to diverge.
conventions.md:103 requires a Keep-a-Changelog `[Unreleased]` entry for changes, and the new notifier, channel and docs are not recorded there.
The audit lane is checked only through `config()`, so the explicit task requirement that `Log::channel('audit')->info('...', [...])` accept a write (task.md:61-62) has no test exercising it.

Notifier tests override `config(['services.discord.webhook_url' => ...])` directly, so the new `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL` -> `services.discord.webhook_url` mapping in config/services.php is never verified.
A file-scope `const WEBHOOK` pollutes the global namespace for the whole test process; a local variable or Pest helper would avoid cross-file collisions.
The `Stringable` handling in `redact()`/`format()` and the object-class fallback are beyond the required scalar/array value cases and are not exercised by any test, so they are unverified extra code.

review.summary: Adds `App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert` with config-driven, non-throwing Discord webhook posting, key/bearer redaction, 1800-char multibyte truncation and URL-scrubbed error logging, plus the archive/audit logging lanes, env keys, a docs/ops guide and Pest tests. All task requirements and the contract are met and the implementation reads cleanly, but documentation sync (logging.md/README/CHANGELOG) and a couple of test gaps keep it at approve-with-nits.
